entries.title: Add more than one Claude login
entries.body: Settings now offers Add another Claude login once Claude is connected. Each login you add signs in through Claude's own sign-in and gets its own row, which you can pause, prefer or remove without touching your first login. A login you add shows its allowance after its first turn. While you keep an added login, an older version of Infinitary will not open your saved work; remove the logins you added before going back to one. Removing the Claude login your first mate runs on now tells you whether another Claude login takes over.

picture.alt: The subscriptions list in Settings with two Claude rows, the second named by its email, above the Add account row
